assumptions: Synthetic fixtures can exercise governance intake. Real source rights, eligibility, window and yield precede collection. Organization/workload identity can be explicitly resolved, and external reviewer independence requires declaration and evidence rather than environment separation.
compatibility: No current market, adoption-track or release schema changes. Later versioned governance intake contracts have migration/review notes; independent-validation semantics and frozen historical decisions are preserved.
domain: Offline synthetic organizations and 1-3 workload families with distinct organization, environment, workload, episode, contribution and reproduction units; future admitted local pilots remain prospectively bounded.
execution_contract: Future local stdlib-only intake/validator/report and reviewed decision proposals; no outreach, interviews, remote mutation, provider/network calls, automatic release-status change, research approval or publication.
hypotheses: Inspectable reports may reduce diagnostic uncertainty or integration effort in admitted workloads; null/negative or infeasible pilots remain valid completed reports and can narrow or reject that hypothesis.
observation_contract: Eligible/deduplicated unit counts, metric formulas/units/denominators, source hashes, observed completion/errors/timing separate from proxy labels, complete missingness, contribution replay and reviewer externality/conflicts.

scenarios.given: Synthetic frame, aliases/overlapping labels and non-admitted real sources
scenarios.planned_evidence: SC-001 future tests: frame/window hashes, independent unit counts, aliases/cross-labels and rights-gap rejection outputs.
scenarios.test_name: SC-001 acceptance contract for future implementation tests
scenarios.then: Stable distinct IDs and eligibility reasons persist; duplicate units do not count twice and non-admitted real records reject
scenarios.when: The future frame/window register validates intake

requirements.text: Freeze eligible evidence units and source rights with canonical organization/workload deduplication.

scenarios.given: Fixed synthetic counts, costs and missing/excluded evidence
scenarios.planned_evidence: SC-002 future tests: independently fixed arithmetic, manifest/source/output hashes and unit/proxy/missingness controls.
scenarios.test_name: SC-002 acceptance contract for future implementation tests
scenarios.then: Correct unit-bearing outputs retain hashes and denominators without cross-unit sums, popularity substitution or missing-as-zero

requirements.text: Bind reproducible metric units, formulas, baselines, denominators and observed/proxy distinctions to evidence.

scenarios.given: Fixed task/baseline/report episodes and synthetic judgment/timing/failure cases
scenarios.planned_evidence: SC-003 future tests: synthetic episode expected outcomes, full-cost/missingness evidence and prospectively frozen real-pilot permission/yield/rubric/assignment/adjudication rules.
scenarios.test_name: SC-003 acceptance contract for future implementation tests
scenarios.then: Observed completion/errors remain separate from judgments, all cost components/episodes remain visible and real comparison needs frozen rights/protocol
scenarios.when: Episode intake and cost aggregation run

requirements.text: Record local report-usability observations and the full integration-cost boundary under a prospective pilot.

scenarios.given: Replayable divergence, duplicates, rights gaps and unreplayable inputs
scenarios.planned_evidence: SC-004 future tests: replay inputs/commands/results, expected divergence and intake disposition/rights/duplicate controls.
scenarios.test_name: SC-004 acceptance contract for future implementation tests
scenarios.then: Admitted/rejected/pending states and reasons preserve negative/inconclusive evidence without count-based correctness claims
scenarios.when: Local contribution intake validates each record

requirements.text: Preserve contribution and counterexample rights, replay/minimization and review dispositions.

scenarios.given: Internal, anonymous, qualifying synthetic external and incomplete/stale dossiers
scenarios.planned_evidence: SC-005 future tests: identity/affiliation/externality/conflict and command/environment/hash controls, negative outcomes and reviewed proposal outputs.
scenarios.test_name: SC-005 acceptance contract for future implementation tests
scenarios.then: Internal stays internal; incomplete external evidence stays pending; no release status changes automatically
scenarios.when: Reproduction status and proposed release updates are checked

requirements.text: Require qualifying external reviewer identity and immutable reproduction evidence while retaining internal status for maintainer reruns.

scenarios.given: Each original obligation and pinned current repository/release/review evidence
scenarios.planned_evidence: SC-006 future audit: original before/after hashes, exact current evidence bindings and obligation-specific proposed dispositions.
scenarios.test_name: SC-006 acceptance contract for future implementation tests
scenarios.then: Every obligation has evidence/authority/remaining decision and unsupported work stays pending without historical approval inference
scenarios.when: The current historical-task audit is performed

requirements.text: Reconcile SPEC-002 T006 and SPEC-009 T009 with separate current evidence and decisions while preserving frozen records.

scenarios.given: Stale/missing/withdrawn/contradictory records and fixed synthetic inputs
scenarios.planned_evidence: SC-007 future tests: twice-run byte parity, fixed audit counts, hash/window/rights/missingness negative-case diagnostics.
scenarios.test_name: SC-007 acceptance contract for future implementation tests
scenarios.then: Affected metrics invalidate with reasons/denominators; identical admitted inputs produce identical outputs without private disclosures
scenarios.when: Validator/report runs and bound inputs are mutated

requirements.text: Report missingness, drift, withdrawal and contradictory evidence deterministically within the privacy boundary.

scenarios.given: Program outputs and current historical reconciliation
scenarios.planned_evidence: SC-008 future packet: requirement/test/evidence matrix, actual candidate/check results, raw input/manifest links and explicit contact/research/publication gates.
scenarios.test_name: SC-008 acceptance contract for future implementation tests
scenarios.then: Observed/proxy/hypothesis and independence/claim limits remain explicit with raw links and pending decisions
scenarios.when: A current milestone packet is assembled

requirements.text: Prepare evidence-based milestone decisions without automatic outreach, research approval or publication.

scientific_limits: Synthetic registers do not establish real adoption, demand, causal benefit, billed savings, scientific novelty or independent validation. Small/self-selected clusters, founder participation and missing data bound future inference; no general confluence or Yang-Baxter claim follows.
scope: A planned local adoption/impact evidence register, metric manifest, usability/integration-cost intake, contribution/counterexample/reproduction dossiers and current historical-task reconciliation; first implementation uses synthetic records.
